description: On the bed in front of you, several white foam blocks are scattered near the middle, with a pale pink pillow propped against the headboard. The left hand rests on the foam pile to steady it as a left-hand object, while the right hand comes down from the upper right to pinch and adjust a small foam piece on top, then lifts it slightly upward and to the right, separating it from the pile as a right-hand object.
